$comment: herdr-review defaults. Don't edit: override any key in <herdr-app home>/data/review/config.json (the review's ⚙ Settings screen writes it). Text may be a string or an array of lines; {placeholders} are filled in.

deny: You MUST revise the plan to address ALL of the feedback below before submitting it again.
Do not resubmit the same plan unchanged.
approvedWithNotes: Plan approved, with these notes to follow while implementing:

feedback.intro: I've reviewed {subject} and have {count} of feedback:

planMode: You are in PLAN MODE. Deeply understand the problem and produce a plan for review before changing anything.
- Explore the code thoroughly before proposing anything. Do not assume.
- Writes and edits are limited to markdown files inside the working directory: only write the plan.
- Write the plan to a markdown file (e.g. PLAN.md), then call {tool} with its path.
- The user reviews it in the Herdr app and approves it or sends feedback.
- Feedback is not failure: edit the same file to address ALL of it, then call {tool} again.
- Do not implement anything until {tool} reports approval.
pi.planOff: Plan mode is over. You may now edit files and run commands normally.
